method: Visual review of the actual Urban RGB orthophoto with the 93 GeoAI outlines, followed by the 17 geometry-passing roof close-ups. This is a qualitative image review without an independent building inventory.

exclude_from_asset.Building_0018: Small side strip on a much larger high-rise roof. The visible building width is unsupported by this isolated detection.
exclude_from_asset.Building_0029: Narrow rooftop fragment from a larger high-rise. Extrusion as a separate full-height building yields a misleading thin tower.
exclude_from_asset.Building_0045: Only one wing of a cross-shaped tower roof is detected. Its extrusion alone would misrepresent the tower outline.
exclude_from_asset.Building_0047: Short fragment of a large construction roof. The surrounding building extent is not represented.

clear_false_positive_examples.Building_0051: Main parking lot, painted bays and pavement.
clear_false_positive_examples.Building_0053: Parking pavement between visible parked cars.
clear_false_positive_examples.Building_0085: Painted outdoor play surface, including the graphic on the pavement.
clear_false_positive_examples.Building_0086: Painted outdoor play surface and adjoining path.

other_visual_limitations: The central row of three cross-shaped roofs contains uncovered roof surfaces and detached partial segments. The southern complex has missed tower outlines around the blue painted courtyard.
Several accepted footprints correspond to visible roof sections or adjoining sections rather than cadastral boundaries.
Building_0080 is a roofed agricultural structure with greenhouse-like appearance. Building use was not independently verified.
The five listed false positives are clear examples, not a census of all false positives. There are no precision, recall or height-accuracy claims.
